<!-- ================= 04 SHAPES ================= -->
<section class="section sec-alt" id="shapes">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head" data-reveal>
      <span class="kicker">04 · The shape library</span>
      <h2>Every shape is a <em>node count</em> in disguise</h2>
      <p class="lede">Chemists memorise these silhouettes; the wave picture lets you derive them. Each contour below is where the standing wave’s amplitude reaches 55% of its maximum — the lobes are simply where the wave’s energy lives.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="shapes" id="shapeGrid">
      <div class="shape" data-n="1" data-l="s" data-reveal>
        <svg viewBox="-60 -60 120 120"><circle r="46" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".85"/><circle r="46" fill="none" stroke="var(--plus)" stroke-width="1" opacity=".5"/><circle r="6" fill="var(--hot)"/></svg>
        <span class="tag">s · <em>ℓ=0</em></span><span class="mdeg">m = 0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="shape" data-n="2" data-l="p" data-reveal style="--d:.05s">
        <svg viewBox="-60 -60 120 120"><ellipse cx="-24" cy="0" rx="26" ry="15" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".85" transform="rotate(45 -24 0)"/><ellipse cx="24" cy="0" rx="26" ry="15" fill="var(--minus)" opacity=".8" transform="rotate(45 24 0)"/><line x1="-17" y1="-17" x2="17" y2="17" stroke="var(--faint)" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/></svg>
        <span class="tag">p · <em>ℓ=1</em></span><span class="mdeg">m = 0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="shape" data-n="2" data-l="p" data-reveal style="--d:.1s">
        <svg viewBox="-60 -60 120 120"><ellipse cx="-24" cy="0" rx="26" ry="15" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".85" transform="rotate(-45 -24 0)"/><ellipse cx="24" cy="0" rx="26" ry="15" fill="var(--minus)" opacity=".8" transform="rotate(-45 24 0)"/><line x1="17" y1="-17" x2="-17" y2="17" stroke="var(--faint)" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/></svg>
        <span class="tag">p · <em>ℓ=1</em></span><span class="mdeg">m = ±1</span>
      </div>
      <div class="shape" data-n="3" data-l="d" data-reveal style="--d:.15s">
        <svg viewBox="-60 -60 120 120"><ellipse cx="-26" cy="-26" rx="20" ry="12" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".85" transform="rotate(45 -26 -26)"/><ellipse cx="26" cy="-26" rx="20" ry="12" fill="var(--minus)" opacity=".8" transform="rotate(-45 26 -26)"/><ellipse cx="26" cy="26" rx="20" ry="12" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".7" transform="rotate(45 26 26)"/><ellipse cx="-26" cy="26" rx="20" ry="12" fill="var(--minus)" opacity=".7" transform="rotate(-45 -26 26)"/></svg>

<script>
/* =====================================================================
   Standingwaves — physics, rendering & interactions
   ===================================================================== */
(function(){
"use strict";
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const $$ = s => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
const clamp = (v,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v));
const TAU = Math.PI*2;
const reduceMotion = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

/* ---------- theme ---------- */
const themeBtn = $("#themeBtn"), themeLabel = $("#themeLabel");
function setTheme(t){
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", t);
  const light = t === "light";

  if(window.__swRepaint) window.__swRepaint(); /* refresh rendered clouds with new palette */
}
let savedTheme = null;
try{ savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("sw-theme"); }catch(e){}
setTheme(savedTheme === "light" ? "light" : "dark");
themeBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
  setTheme(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
});

/* ---------- css var reader ---------- */
function cssVar(name){
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
}
function palette(){
  return {
    plus: cssVar("--plus"), minus: cssVar("--minus"),
    line: cssVar("--line-strong"), faint: cssVar("--faint"),
    text: cssVar("--text"), accent: cssVar("--accent")
  };
}

/* ---------- scroll: reveal, progress, nav state ---------- */
const nav = $("#nav"), progress = $("#progress");
addEventListener("scroll", ()=>{
  const h = document.documentElement;
  const p = h.scrollTop / Math.max(1, h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight);
  progress.style.transform = "scaleX(" + p + ")";
  nav.classList.toggle("scrolled", h.scrollTop > 12);
}, {passive:true});

const revealIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
  es.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add("in"); revealIO.unobserve(e.target); }});
},{threshold:.12, rootMargin:"0px 0px -6% 0px"});
$$("[data-reveal]").forEach(el=>revealIO.observe(el));

/* ---------- scramble-decode kickers ---------- */
function scramble(el){
  const finalText = el.dataset.text || el.textContent;
  el.dataset.text = finalText;
  const glyphs = "ψΔλℏ∑∫≡≈±·×∴∵◦∂";
  let frame = 0;
  const total = Math.max(14, finalText.length * 1.6);
  (function tick(){
    let out = "";
    for(let i=0;i<finalText.length;i++){
      const revealAt = (i / finalText.length) * total * .7;
      if(finalText[i] === " " || frame > revealAt) out += finalText[i];
      else out += glyphs[(Math.random()*glyphs.length)|0];
    }
    el.textContent = out;
    if(frame++ < total) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    else el.textContent = finalText;
  })();
}
const scrIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
  es.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ scramble(e.target); scrIO.unobserve(e.target); }});
},{threshold:.4});
$$("[data-scramble]").forEach(el=> scrIO.observe(el));

/* ---------- nav active link ---------- */
const linkMap = {};
$$(".nav-links a").forEach(a=>{ linkMap[a.getAttribute("href").slice(1)] = a; });
const secIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
  es.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      $$(".nav-links a").forEach(a=>a.classList.remove("active"));
      const a = linkMap[e.target.id];
      if(a) a.classList.add("active");
    }
  });
},{rootMargin:"-40% 0px -50% 0px"});
["standing","shots","shapes","numbers","history"].forEach(id=>{
  const el = document.getElementById(id); if(el) secIO.observe(el);
});

/* ---------- parallax on hero ---------- */
const parEls = $$("[data-par]");
if(!reduceMotion && parEls.length){
  addEventListener("pointermove", e=>{
    const x = e.clientX/innerWidth - .5, y = e.clientY/innerHeight - .5;
    parEls.forEach(el=>{
      const f = parseFloat(el.dataset.par) * 100;
      el.style.transform = "translate3d(" + (x*f) + "px," + (y*f*1.4) + "px,0)";
    });
  }, {passive:true});
}

/* =====================================================================
   WAVE MATH
   ===================================================================== */
function factorial(n){ let r=1; for(let i=2;i<=n;i++) r*=i; return r; }
function assocLegendre(l,m,x){
  const am = Math.abs(m);
  let p = 1;
  for(let k=1;k<=am;k++) p *= (1 - x*x) * .5 / k;
  p *= factorial(am + am - 1) / (factorial(am)*2);
  if(m < 0) p *= Math.pow(-1, am);
  let pm = p;                       /* P_am */
  if(l === am) return pm;
  let pl = (2*x*am + 1) * pm;       /* P_{am+1} */
  for(let ll=am+2; ll<=l; ll++){
    const tmp = ((2*ll - 1)*x*pl - (ll + am - 1)*pm) / (ll - am);
    pm = pl; pl = tmp;
  }
  return pl;
}
function Ylm(l,m,theta,phi){
  const x = Math.cos(theta);
  let N = Math.sqrt((2*l + 1) / (4*Math.PI) * factorial(l - Math.abs(m)) / factorial(l + Math.abs(m)));
  let P = assocLegendre(l, Math.abs(m), x);
  let e;
  if(m === 0)      e = .5*Math.sqrt(2);                    /* real form cos(mφ) normalisation */
  else if(m > 0)   e = Math.cos(m*phi);
  else             e = Math.sin(-m*phi);
  return N * P * e;
}
function radial(n,l,r){
  /* analytic hydrogen radial factor R_{nl}(r), in Bohr units */
  const rho = 2*r / n;
  const k = n - 1 - l;
  /* associated Laguerre L_k^{α}(x), α = 2ℓ+1, via the three-term recurrence
     (i+1)² L_{i+1} = (2i+1+α−x) L_i − (i+α) L_{i−1}            */
  const alpha = 2*l + 1;
  let Lm1 = 1, L0 = 1 + alpha - rho;
  let L1 = L0;
  if(k === 0) L1 = Lm1;
  else if(k === 1) L1 = L0;
  else for(let i=1; i<k; i++){
    L1 = ((2*i + 1 + alpha - rho)*L0 - (i + alpha)*Lm1) / ((i + 1)*(i + 1));
    Lm1 = L0; L0 = L1;
  }
  return Math.pow(rho, l) * L1 * Math.exp(-rho/2);
}
const SHOTS = [
  {n:1,l:0,m:0},
  {n:2,l:0,m:0}, {n:2,l:1,m:-1}, {n:2,l:1,m:0}, {n:2,l:1,m:1},
  {n:3,l:0,m:0}, {n:3,l:1,m:0}, {n:3,l:2,m:-2}, {n:3,l:2,m:-1}, {n:3,l:2,m:0}, {n:3,l:2,m:1}, {n:3,l:2,m:2}
];
function shotName(s){
  const L = "spdf" [s.l] || (s.l+"");
  const sub = (x)=>String(x).replace(/\d/g, d=>"₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉"[d]);
  return "ψ" + sub(s.n) + sub(s.l) + (s.m<0?"−":"") + sub(Math.abs(s.m));
}

/* =====================================================================
   1 · HERO — 2p orbital with circulating wave packet
   ===================================================================== */
const hero = (()=>{
  const cv = $("#heroCanvas"); if(!cv) return null;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  let W=0,H=0,cx=0,cy=0,R=0, dpr=1, raf=null;
  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio||1);
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = b.width; H = b.height;
    cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    cx = W/2; cy = H/2 + 6;
    R = Math.min(W,H) * .36;
    if(cv._repaint) cv._repaint();
  }
  const N = 180;
  const pts = Array.from({length:N}, (_,i)=> i/N*TAU);
  const cloud = new Float32Array(N);
  let phi0 = 0, t = 0;
  function draw(){
    const pal = palette();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    /* faint reference ring (the "orbit") */
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = pal.line; ctx.setLineDash([2,6]); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = .5;
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    /* nucleus */
    const ng = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,26);
    ng.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,84,104,.9)"); ng.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,84,104,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = ng; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,26,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.minus; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,3.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();

    /* |Y(θ)|² sampled around the ring (θ from vertical) */
    let max = 1e-9;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      const th = pts[i];
      const v = Math.abs(Ylm(1,0,th,0));      /* |cosθ|² shape */
      cloud[i] = v; if(v>max) max=v;
    }
    /* cloud ribbon: width ∝ amplitude, coloured by sign of Y */
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      const a = pts[i];
      const x1 = cx + Math.sin(a)*R, y1 = cy - Math.cos(a)*R;
      const a2 = pts[(i+1)%N];
      const x2 = cx + Math.sin(a2)*R, y2 = cy - Math.cos(a2)*R;
      const w = 1.2 + (cloud[i]/max) * 13;
      const sgn = Ylm(1,0,a,0) >= 0 ? pal.plus : pal.minus;
      ctx.strokeStyle = sgn; ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.globalAlpha = .28 + .55*(cloud[i]/max);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1,y1); ctx.lineTo(x2,y2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    /* travelling packet: bright electron marker */
    const ea = phi0;
    const ex = cx + Math.sin(ea)*R, ey = cy - Math.cos(ea)*R;
    const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ex,ey,0,ex,ey,20);
    eg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,.95)");
    eg.addColorStop(.35, pal.accent);
    eg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = eg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex,ey,20,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    /* trail */
    for(let k=1;k<=26;k++){
      const ta = ea - k*.05;
      ctx.globalAlpha = .5*(1 - k/26);
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + Math.sin(ta)*R, cy - Math.cos(ta)*R, 2.6*(1-k/26)+.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  let last = 0;
  function loop(ts){
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(ts - last < 16) return;
    last = ts;
    t += .016; phi0 += .028;
    draw();
  }
  resize();
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(cv);
  const visIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
    es.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ if(!raf && !reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
      else if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    });
  },{threshold:.05});
  visIO.observe(cv);
  if(reduceMotion) draw();
  cv._repaint = draw;
  return cv;
})();

/* =====================================================================
   2 · WAVE LAB — standing or not
   ===================================================================== */
const lab = (()=>{
  const cv = $("#labCanvas"); if(!cv) return null;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const nSlider = $("#nSlider"), ampSlider = $("#ampSlider");
  const nVal = $("#nVal"), ampVal = $("#ampVal");
  const verdict = $("#verdict"), hud = $("#labHud2");
  let N = 3.3, AMP = .6, phase = 0, raf = null, W=0,H=0,dpr=1;

  function setFill(el, val, min, max){
    el.style.setProperty("--fill", ((val-min)/(max-min)*100) + "%");
  }
  function standing(){ return Number.isInteger(N) && N >= 1; }
  function update(){
    nVal.textContent = (N % 1 === 0 ? N.toFixed(0) : N.toFixed(2).replace(/0$/,"")) + "λ around orbit";
    ampVal.textContent = Math.round(AMP*100) + "%";
    setFill(nSlider, N, 1, 9);
    setFill(ampSlider, AMP, 10, 100);
    const ok = standing();
    const near = Math.abs(N - Math.round(N)) < .045;
    verdict.className = "verdict " + (ok ? "ok" : "bad");
    if(ok){
      verdict.innerHTML = "<b>✔ Standing wave — orbit allowed (n = " + N + ")</b>" +
        "2π = " + N + "λ closes exactly. " + N + " nodes; the pattern freezes in place and the Bohr orbit with this angular momentum is stable.";
      hud.textContent = "standing mode · n = " + N;
      hud.style.color = "var(--accent-2)";
    }else{
      verdict.innerHTML = "<b>✘ Not standing — this orbit cannot exist</b>" +
        "The wave misses its own tail by " + (near ? "≈ 0" : Math.abs(N - Math.round(N)).toFixed(2)) + "λ. Traveling crests interfere destructively and the pattern washes out. Nudge λ toward an integer.";
      hud.textContent = "traveling mode · Δ = " + (near ? "≈ 0" : Math.abs(N - Math.round(N)).toFixed(2)) + "λ";
      hud.style.color = "var(--hot)";
    }
    $$("#presetChips .chip").forEach(c=> c.classList.toggle("on", +c.dataset.n === Math.round(N) && N%1===0));
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }
  nSlider.addEventListener("input", ()=>{ N = +nSlider.value; update(); });
  ampSlider.addEventListener("input", ()=>{ AMP = +ampSlider.value/100; update(); });
  $$("#presetChips .chip").forEach(c=> c.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    nSlider.value = c.dataset.n; N = +c.dataset.n; update();
  }));

  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio||1);
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = b.width; H = b.height;
    cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }
  function draw(){
    const pal = palette();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2, R = Math.min(W,H)/2 - 44;
    const amp = AMP * R * .30;
    /* orbit ring */
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = pal.line; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = .8; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    /* wave */
    const steps = 520;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const a = i/steps * TAU;
      const w = Math.sin(N*a - phase);
      const rr = R + amp * w;
      const x = cx + Math.sin(a)*rr, y = cy - Math.cos(a)*rr;
      i ? ctx.lineTo(x,y) : ctx.moveTo(x,y);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = pal.accent; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.shadowColor = pal.accent; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    /* node markers when standing */
    if(standing()){
      const nI = Math.round(N);
      for(let k=0;k<nI;k++){
        const na = (k + .5) / nI * TAU; /* zeros of sin(nθ): θ = (k+½)π/n */
        const x = cx + Math.sin(na)*R, y = cy - Math.cos(na)*R;
        ctx.fillStyle = pal.minus;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = pal.minus; ctx.globalAlpha = .4; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,7,0,TAU); ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    }
    /* nucleus */
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.faint; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    /* label at right */
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.faint; ctx.font = "11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("r", cx + R + 14, cy + 4);
  }
  let last = 0;
  function loop(ts){
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(ts - last < 20) return;
    last = ts;
    phase += standing() ? 0 : .05;
    draw();
  }
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(cv);
  const visIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
    es.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ if(!raf && !reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
      else if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    });
  },{threshold:.05});
  visIO.observe(cv);
  cv._repaint = draw;
  update();
  return {update};
})();

/* =====================================================================
   3 · ORBITAL LAB — 3D point cloud of ψ
   ===================================================================== */
const orb = (()=>{
  const cv = $("#orbCanvas"); if(!cv) return null;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const picker = $("#shotPicker");
  let W=0,H=0,dpr=1, shot = SHOTS[0], rotX = -.35, rotY = .6, auto = !reduceMotion;
  let dragging = false, px = 0, py = 0, raf = null;
  let pts = [], maxA = 1;

  /* build the picker */
  SHOTS.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "shot-btn" + (i===0 ? " on" : "");
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Select " + shotName(s));
    const L = "spdf"[s.l];
    const mini = miniIcon(s.l, s.m);
    b.innerHTML = mini + '<span class="sl">' + s.n + L + '<small style="color:var(--faint)"> m=' + (s.m<0?"−":"") + Math.abs(s.m) + '</small></span>';
    b.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      $$(".shot-btn").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("on"));
      b.classList.add("on");
      select(i);
    });
    picker.appendChild(b);
  });
  function miniIcon(l,m){
    /* small 2D schematic of the angular shape */
    const P = (x,y,rx,ry,fill,op,rot)=> '<ellipse cx="'+x+'" cy="'+y+'" rx="'+rx+'" ry="'+ry+'" fill="'+fill+'" opacity="'+op+'" transform="rotate('+(rot||0)+' '+x+' '+y+')"/>';
    if(l===0) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60"><circle r="22" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".9"/><circle r="3" fill="var(--hot)"/></svg>';
    if(l===1){
      if(m===0) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(0,-14,11,15,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(0,14,11,15,"var(--minus)",.8)+'<line x1="-26" y1="0" x2="26" y2="0" stroke="var(--faint)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>';
      if(m===-1) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-14,0,15,11,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(14,0,15,11,"var(--minus)",.8)+'</svg>';
      return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-11,-11,11,8,"var(--plus)",.9,45)+P(11,11,11,8,"var(--minus)",.8,45)+'</svg>';
    }
    if(l===2){
      if(Math.abs(m)===2) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-13,-13,9,6,"var(--plus)",.9,45)+P(13,-13,9,6,"var(--minus)",.8,45)+P(13,13,9,6,"var(--plus)",.75,45)+P(-13,13,9,6,"var(--minus)",.75,45)+'</svg>';
      if(m===0) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-15,0,9,13,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(15,0,9,13,"var(--minus)",.8)+P(0,-16,10,7,"var(--plus)",.6)+P(0,16,10,7,"var(--minus)",.6)+'</svg>';
      return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-13,0,9,13,"var(--plus)",.9,90)+P(13,0,9,13,"var(--minus)",.8,90)+P(0,-15,9,13,"var(--plus)",.6)+P(0,15,9,13,"var(--minus)",.6)+'</svg>';
    }
    return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-12,-8,8,5,"var(--plus)",.9,30)+P(10,-12,8,5,"var(--minus)",.8,-30)+P(12,10,8,5,"var(--plus)",.7,30)+P(-10,12,8,5,"var(--minus)",.7,-30)+P(0,0,5,5,"var(--plus)",.5)+'</svg>';
  }

  function select(i){
    shot = SHOTS[i];
    const rMax = 3 + 2.6*shot.n + (shot.n===1?0:1.4);
    const COUNT = 5200;
    pts = [];
    let mx = 1e-9;
    /* rejection-sample (r,θ,φ) with density ∝ r²|Y|²|R|² */
    let guard = 0;
    while(pts.length < COUNT && guard < COUNT*40){
      guard++;
      const r = Math.pow(Math.random(), .85) * rMax;
      const th = Math.acos(2*Math.random() - 1);
      const ph = Math.random()*TAU;
      const Y = Ylm(shot.l, shot.m, th, ph);
      const Rr = radial(shot.n, shot.l, r);
      const a = r*r * Y*Y * Rr*Rr;
      if(a <= 0) continue;
      if(a > mx) mx = a;
      if(Math.random() < a/mx * .55){
        pts.push([r*Math.sin(th)*Math.cos(ph), r*Math.sin(th)*Math.sin(ph), r*Math.cos(th), a, Y>=0?1:-1]);
      }
    }
    maxA = mx;
    const rad = shot.n - shot.l - 1, ang = shot.l;
    $("#orbLabel").textContent = "ψ = " + shotName(shot);
    $("#orbStats").textContent = "nodes " + (shot.n-1) + " · radial " + rad + " · angles " + ang;
    $("#roN").textContent = shot.n;
    $("#roL").textContent = shot.l;
    $("#roM").textContent = shot.m;
    $("#roNodes").textContent = shot.n - 1;
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }

  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio||1);
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = b.width; H = b.height;
    cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }

  function draw(){
    const pal = palette();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2, S = Math.min(W,H)/2 / (3 + 2.6*shot.n + (shot.n===1?0:1.4) + 1.1);
    /* axes */
    const ax = (u)=>{
      const v = rotVec(u);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - v[0]*S*1.12, cy - v[1]*S*1.12);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + v[0]*S*1.12, cy + v[1]*S*1.12);
      ctx.strokeStyle = pal.line; ctx.globalAlpha = .35; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    };
    const rotVec = (u)=>{
      let x=u[0], y=u[1], z=u[2];
      let c=Math.cos(rotY), s=Math.sin(rotY);
      let x2 = x*c - z*s, z2 = x*s + z*c;
      let c2=Math.cos(rotX), s2=Math.sin(rotX);
      let y2 = y*c2 - z2*s2, z3 = y*s2 + z2*c2;
      return [x2, y2, z3];
    };
    ax([1,0,0]); ax([0,1,0]); ax([0,0,1]);
    /* z axis label */
    const zv = rotVec([0,0,1]);
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.faint; ctx.font = "10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    ctx.fillText("z", cx + zv[0]*S*1.16 - 3, cy + zv[1]*S*1.16);
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.minus; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();

    const cX=Math.cos(rotX), sX=Math.sin(rotX), cY=Math.cos(rotY), sY=Math.sin(rotY);
    const list = [];
    for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
      const p = pts[i];
      let x=p[0], y=p[1], z=p[2];
      let x2 = x*cY - z*sY, z2 = x*sY + z*cY;
      let y2 = y*cX - z2*sX, z3 = y*sX + z2*cX;
      const depth = (z3 + (3 + 2.6*shot.n)) / (2*(3 + 2.6*shot.n)); /* 0 far → 1 near */
      const a = clamp(p[3]/maxA, 0, 1);
      list.push([cx + x2*S, cy + y2*S, depth, a]);
    }
    /* painter-ish: draw far first */
    list.sort((A,B)=> A[2]-B[2]);
    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      const P = list[i];
      const d = P[2];
      const size = (1 + d*1.9);
      const alpha = (.10 + d*.5) * (.35 + .65*P[3]);
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(alpha,0,.85);
      /* colour by the sign of the wavefunction: + lobe vs − lobe */
      ctx.fillStyle = P[4] >= 0 ? pal.plus : pal.minus;
      ctx.fillRect(P[0]-size/2, P[1]-size/2, size, size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  let last = 0;
  function loop(ts){
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(ts - last < 16) return;
    last = ts;
    if(auto && !dragging) rotY += .005;
    draw();
  }
  cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", e=>{ dragging = true; px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY; cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); });
  cv.addEventListener("pointermove", e=>{
    if(!dragging) return;
    rotY += (e.clientX - px) * .008;
    rotX = clamp(rotX + (e.clientY - py) * .008, -1.4, 1.4);
    px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY;
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  });
  ["pointerup","pointercancel","pointerleave"].forEach(ev=> cv.addEventListener(ev, ()=> dragging=false));

  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(cv);
  const visIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
    es.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ if(!raf && !reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
      else if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    });
  },{threshold:.05});
  visIO.observe(cv);
  cv._repaint = draw;
  select(0);
  return {canvas: cv, select};
})();

/* =====================================================================
   4 · Shape cards → jump to the matching shot in the 3D lab
   ===================================================================== */
window.__swRepaint = function(){
  ["heroCanvas","labCanvas","orbCanvas"].forEach(id=>{
    const c = document.getElementById(id);
    if(c && c._repaint) c._repaint();
  });
};
$$(".shape").forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    const idx = SHOTS.findIndex(s => s.n === +el.dataset.n && "spdf"[s.l] === el.dataset.l);
    if(idx >= 0){
      const btns = $$(".shot-btn");
      btns.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("on"));
      btns[idx].classList.add("on");
      orb.select(idx);
      document.getElementById("lab2").scrollIntoView({behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth"});
    }
  });
});

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

input[type="range"]{

.chips{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.5rem}
.chip{
  font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11.5px; padding:.5em .9em; border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--muted); transition:all .2s;
}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--text); transform:translateY(-1px)}
.chip.on{background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:#fff; font-weight:700}

.verdict{
  border-radius:14px; padding:1em 1.15em; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5; border:1px solid var(--line);

.lab-main{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1rem}
.stage{
  position:relative; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; overflow:hidden;

}
.shot-visual::before{

.shot-btn{

.qlab-view{

.stat .big small{font-size:.5em; color:var(--muted); font-weight:400; font-style:italic}
.stat .lab2{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-top:.5rem}
.stat p{font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin:.7rem 0 0}

/* ================= TIMELINE ================= */
.tl{position:relative; margin-top:3rem; padding-left:2.2rem; max-width:860px}

.tl-year{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.22em; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700}
.tl-item h3{font-size:1.22rem; margin:.25em 0 .3em}
.tl-item p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14.5px; margin:0; max-width:62ch}

/* ================= CLOSER ================= */
.closer{border-block:1px solid var(--line); background:
  radial-gradient(50% 60% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent), transparent 70%), var(--bg-2)}

.pull b{font-style:normal; color:var(--accent-2); font-weight:560}
.pull .hot{color:var(--hot); font-style:normal; font-weight:560}
.refs{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.4rem; max-width:560px; margin-inline:auto; text-align:left}
.refs div{display:flex; gap:.9em; font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; padding:.55em .9em; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; background:var(--card); transition:border-color .25s, transform .25s}
.refs div:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong); transform:translateX(4px)}
.refs span{color:var(--accent); min-width:2em}

/* ================= FOOTER ================= */
footer{padding:2.6rem 0 3rem; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.foot{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1.2rem; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:13px; color:var(--muted)}
.foot .mono{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint)}

<!-- ================= 01 STANDING WAVE ================= -->

      <span class="kicker">01 · The rule of closure</span>
      <h2>Orbits that <em>fit</em> — and the ones that don’t</h2>
      <p class="lede">In 1913 Niels Bohr wrote a strange restriction on the hydrogen atom: an electron may orbit only at radii where an <strong>integer number of its wavelengths</strong> wraps exactly around the circle. De Broglie’s 1924 insight turned that ad hoc rule into physics — the electron <em>is</em> a wave, and only standing waves are stable. Try it below.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="lab">

          </div>

            <div class="ctrl-head"><label>Presets</label></div>
            <div class="chips" id="presetChips" role="group" aria-label="Wavelength presets">
              <button class="chip" data-n="2">2λ</button>
              <button class="chip" data-n="3">3λ</button>

When <span class="eq">2π = nλ</span>, every crest lands on the crest it just left — the pattern freezes into a <b>standing wave</b> with <span class="eq">n</span> nodes and the orbit becomes a <em>Bohr orbit</em>. <!-- ================= 02 QUANTUM SHOTS ================= -->
<section class="section sec-alt" id="shots">

      <h2>Three waves, folded into <em>one</em> orbital</h2>
      <p class="lede">A full orbital is a product of three independent standing waves: one radial, one polar, one azimuthal. Each carries an integer — the <strong>quantum numbers</strong> <span class="eq">n, ℓ, m</span> — and each integer is simply a node count. The shapes below are the real, analytically computed hydrogen solutions, rendered as probability clouds.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="shot-grid">
      <article class="shot" data-reveal>
        <span class="num">i</span>
        <div class="shot-visual">
          <svg viewBox="-105 -105 210 210" role="img" aria-label="Radial standing wave: concentric rings with one node">
            <g fill="none" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="2" opacity=".9">
              <circle r="18"/><circle r="42"/><circle r="66" opacity=".7"/><circle r="90" opacity=".45"/><circle r="112" opacity=".25"/>
            </g>
            <g stroke="var(--hot)" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="4 5" fill="none" opacity=".85"><circle r="30"/><circle r="54"/><circle r="78"/><circle r="101"/></g>
            <line x1="0" y1="-112" x2="0" y2="112" stroke="var(--line-strong)" stroke-width="1"/>
            <circle r="5" fill="var(--hot)"/>
            <text x="8" y="-88" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="11" fill="var(--faint)">r</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3>Radial wave <em style="color:var(--accent-2);font-style:italic">R<sub>nℓ</sub>(r)</em></h3>
        <p class="desc">The wave breathing in and out along the radius. It must vanish at the nucleus <span class="eq">R(0)=0</span> and fade to zero at infinity — a standing wave trapped in a box whose walls are the potential well. Its zeros are the <b>radial nodes</b>.</p>

          <span class="fact"><span class="k">Nodes</span><span class="v"><em>n − ℓ − 1</em></span></span>
          <span class="fact"><span class="k">Quantum no.</span><span class="v">n, ℓ</span></span>
          <span class="fact"><span class="k">Sets</span><span class="v">shell, size & energy</span></span>

/* =====================================================================
   WAVE MATH (Corrected Physics & Numerical Recurrences)
   ===================================================================== */
function factorial(n){
  if(n <= 1) return 1;
  let r = 1;
  for(let i = 2; i <= n; i++) r *= i;
  return r;
}

/* Associated Legendre Polynomials P_l^m(x) with standard Condon-Shortley phase */
function assocLegendre(l, m, x){
  const am = Math.abs(m);
  if(am > l) return 0;

  // P_m^m(x) = (-1)^m * (2m - 1)!! * (1 - x^2)^(m/2)
  let pmm = 1.0;
  if(am > 0){
    const somx2 = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, (1.0 - x) * (1.0 + x)));
    let fact = 1.0;
    for(let i = 1; i <= am; i++){
      pmm *= -fact * somx2;
      fact += 2.0;
    }
  }
  if(l === am) return pmm;

  // P_{m+1}^m(x) = (2m + 1) * x * P_m^m(x)
  let pmp1 = x * (2 * am + 1) * pmm;
  if(l === am + 1) return pmp1;

  // Recurrence: (ll - am) * P_ll^m = (2*ll - 1) * x * P_{ll-1}^m - (ll + am - 1) * P_{ll-2}^m
  let pll = 0;
  for(let ll = am + 2; ll <= l; ll++){
    pll = ((2 * ll - 1) * x * pmp1 - (ll + am - 1) * pmm) / (ll - am);
    pmm = pmp1;
    pmp1 = pll;
  }
  return pll;
}

/* Real Spherical Harmonics Y_lm(theta, phi) */
function Ylm(l, m, theta, phi){
  const x = Math.cos(theta);
  const am = Math.abs(m);
  const N = Math.sqrt(((2 * l + 1) / (4 * Math.PI)) * (factorial(l - am) / factorial(l + am)));
  const P = assocLegendre(l, am, x);
  if(m === 0) return N * P;

  // (-1)^m cancels the Condon-Shortley phase so real orbitals match standard conventions (e.g. p_x > 0 for x > 0)
  const cs = (am % 2 === 1) ? -1 : 1;
  if(m > 0) return cs * Math.SQRT2 * N * P * Math.cos(m * phi);
  return cs * Math.SQRT2 * N * P * Math.sin(am * phi);
}

/* Generalized Laguerre Polynomials L_k^alpha(x) */
function assocLaguerre(k, alpha, x){
  if(k === 0) return 1;
  let Lprev = 1;
  let Lcurr = 1 + alpha - x;
  if(k === 1) return Lcurr;
  for(let i = 1; i < k; i++){
    const Lnext = ((2 * i + 1 + alpha - x) * Lcurr - (i + alpha) * Lprev) / (i + 1);
    Lprev = Lcurr;
    Lcurr = Lnext;
  }
  return Lcurr;
}

/* Analytic Hydrogen Radial Function R_{nl}(r), with r in units of the Bohr radius a_0 */
function radial(n, l, r){
  const rho = (2 * r) / n;
  const k = n - 1 - l;
  const alpha = 2 * l + 1;
  const norm = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(2 / n, 3) * (factorial(k) / (2 * n * factorial(n + l))));
  return norm * Math.pow(rho, l) * assocLaguerre(k, alpha, rho) * Math.exp(-rho / 2);
}

];

function shotName(s){
  const sub = (x)=>String(x).replace(/\d/g, d=>"₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉"[d]);
  return "ψ" + sub(s.n) + sub(s.l) + (s.m<0?"−":"") + sub(Math.abs(s.m));
}

function orbitalLabel(s){
  const L = "spdf"[s.l] || s.l;
  if(s.l === 1){
    if(s.m === 0) return s.n + "p_z";
    if(s.m === 1) return s.n + "p_x";
    if(s.m === -1) return s.n + "p_y";
  }
  if(s.l === 2){
    if(s.m === 0) return s.n + "d_{z²}";
    if(s.m === 1) return s.n + "d_{xz}";
    if(s.m === -1) return s.n + "d_{yz}";
    if(s.m === 2) return s.n + "d_{x²-y²}";
    if(s.m === -2) return s.n + "d_{xy}";
  }
  return s.n + L + (s.m !== 0 ? " (m=" + s.m + ")" : "");
}

/* =====================================================================
   1 · HERO — 2p orbital with circulating wave packet
   ===================================================================== */
const hero = (()=>{
  const cv = $("#heroCanvas"); if(!cv) return null;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  let W=0,H=0,cx=0,cy=0,R=0, dpr=1, raf=null;
  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio||1);
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = b.width; H = b.height;
    cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    cx = W/2; cy = H/2 + 6;
    R = Math.min(W,H) * .36;
    if(cv._repaint) cv._repaint();
  }
  const N = 180;
  const pts = Array.from({length:N}, (_,i)=> i/N*TAU);
  const cloud = new Float32Array(N);
  let phi0 = 0, t = 0;
  function draw(){
    const pal = palette();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    /* faint reference ring (the "orbit") */
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = pal.line; ctx.setLineDash([2,6]); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = .5;
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    /* nucleus */
    const ng = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,26);
    ng.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,84,104,.9)"); ng.addColorStop(1,"rgba(255,84,104,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = ng; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,26,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.minus; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,3.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();

    /* |Y(θ)|² sampled around the ring (θ from vertical) */
    let max = 1e-9;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      const th = pts[i];
      const v = Math.abs(Ylm(1,0,th,0));      /* |cosθ| shape */
      cloud[i] = v; if(v>max) max=v;
    }
    /* cloud ribbon: width ∝ amplitude, coloured by sign of Y */
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      const a = pts[i];
      const x1 = cx + Math.sin(a)*R, y1 = cy - Math.cos(a)*R;
      const a2 = pts[(i+1)%N];
      const x2 = cx + Math.sin(a2)*R, y2 = cy - Math.cos(a2)*R;
      const w = 1.2 + (cloud[i]/max) * 13;
      const sgn = Ylm(1,0,a,0) >= 0 ? pal.plus : pal.minus;
      ctx.strokeStyle = sgn; ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.globalAlpha = .28 + .55*(cloud[i]/max);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1,y1); ctx.lineTo(x2,y2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    /* travelling packet: bright electron marker */
    const ea = phi0;
    const ex = cx + Math.sin(ea)*R, ey = cy - Math.cos(ea)*R;
    const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ex,ey,0,ex,ey,20);
    eg.addColorStop(0,"rgba(255,255,255,.95)");
    eg.addColorStop(.35, pal.accent);
    eg.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = eg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex,ey,20,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    /* trail */
    for(let k=1;k<=26;k++){
      const ta = ea - k*.05;
      ctx.globalAlpha = .5*(1 - k/26);
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + Math.sin(ta)*R, cy - Math.cos(ta)*R, 2.6*(1-k/26)+.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  let last = 0;
  function loop(ts){
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(ts - last < 16) return;
    last = ts;
    t += .016; phi0 += .028;
    draw();
  }
  resize();
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(cv);
  const visIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
    es.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ if(!raf && !reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
      else if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    });
  },{threshold:.05});
  visIO.observe(cv);
  if(reduceMotion) draw();
  cv._repaint = draw;
  return cv;
})();

/* =====================================================================
   2 · WAVE LAB — standing or not
   ===================================================================== */
const lab = (()=>{
  const cv = $("#labCanvas"); if(!cv) return null;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const nSlider = $("#nSlider"), ampSlider = $("#ampSlider");
  const nVal = $("#nVal"), ampVal = $("#ampVal");
  const verdict = $("#verdict"), hud = $("#labHud2");
  let N = 3.3, AMP = .6, phase = 0, raf = null, W=0,H=0,dpr=1;

  function setFill(el, val, min, max){
    el.style.setProperty("--fill", ((val-min)/(max-min)*100) + "%");
  }
  function standing(){ return Number.isInteger(N) && N >= 1; }
  function update(){
    nVal.textContent = (N % 1 === 0 ? N.toFixed(0) : N.toFixed(2).replace(/0$/,"")) + "λ around orbit";
    ampVal.textContent = Math.round(AMP*100) + "%";
    setFill(nSlider, N, 1, 9);
    setFill(ampSlider, AMP, 10, 100);
    const ok = standing();
    const near = Math.abs(N - Math.round(N)) < .045;
    verdict.className = "verdict " + (ok ? "ok" : "bad");
    if(ok){
      verdict.innerHTML = "<b>✔ Standing wave — orbit allowed (n = " + N + ")</b>" +
        "2πr = " + N + "λ closes exactly. " + N + " nodes; the pattern freezes in place and the Bohr orbit with this angular momentum is stable.";
      hud.textContent = "standing mode · n = " + N;
      hud.style.color = "var(--accent-2)";
    }else{
      verdict.innerHTML = "<b>✘ Not standing — this orbit cannot exist</b>" +
        "The wave misses its own tail by " + (near ? "≈ 0" : Math.abs(N - Math.round(N)).toFixed(2)) + "λ. Traveling crests interfere destructively and the pattern washes out. Nudge λ toward an integer.";
      hud.textContent = "traveling mode · Δ = " + (near ? "≈ 0" : Math.abs(N - Math.round(N)).toFixed(2)) + "λ";
      hud.style.color = "var(--hot)";
    }
    $$("#presetChips .chip").forEach(c=> c.classList.toggle("on", +c.dataset.n === Math.round(N) && N%1===0));
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }
  nSlider.addEventListener("input", ()=>{ N = +nSlider.value; update(); });
  ampSlider.addEventListener("input", ()=>{ AMP = +ampSlider.value/100; update(); });
  $$("#presetChips .chip").forEach(c=> c.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    nSlider.value = c.dataset.n; N = +c.dataset.n; update();
  }));

  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio||1);
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = b.width; H = b.height;
    cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }
  function draw(){
    const pal = palette();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2, R = Math.min(W,H)/2 - 44;
    const amp = AMP * R * .30;
    /* orbit ring */
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = pal.line; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = .8; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    /* wave */
    const steps = 520;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const a = i/steps * TAU;
      const w = Math.sin(N*a - phase);
      const rr = R + amp * w;
      const x = cx + Math.sin(a)*rr, y = cy - Math.cos(a)*rr;
      i ? ctx.lineTo(x,y) : ctx.moveTo(x,y);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = pal.accent; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.shadowColor = pal.accent; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    /* node markers when standing */
    if(standing()){
      const nI = Math.round(N);
      for(let k=0;k<nI;k++){
        const na = (k + .5) / nI * TAU; /* zeros of sin(nθ): θ = (k+½)π/n */
        const x = cx + Math.sin(na)*R, y = cy - Math.cos(na)*R;
        ctx.fillStyle = pal.minus;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,3.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = pal.minus; ctx.globalAlpha = .4; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,7,0,TAU); ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    }
    /* nucleus */
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.faint; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    /* label at right */
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.faint; ctx.font = "11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("r", cx + R + 14, cy + 4);
  }
  let last = 0;
  function loop(ts){
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(ts - last < 20) return;
    last = ts;
    phase += standing() ? 0 : .05;
    draw();
  }
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(cv);
  const visIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
    es.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ if(!raf && !reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
      else if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    });
  },{threshold:.05});
  visIO.observe(cv);
  cv._repaint = draw;
  update();
  return {update};
})();

/* =====================================================================
   3 · ORBITAL LAB — 3D point cloud of ψ
   ===================================================================== */
const orb = (()=>{
  const cv = $("#orbCanvas"); if(!cv) return null;
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const picker = $("#shotPicker");
  let W=0,H=0,dpr=1, shot = SHOTS[0], rotX = -.35, rotY = .6, auto = !reduceMotion;
  let dragging = false, px = 0, py = 0, raf = null;
  let pts = [], maxA = 1, currentRMax = 10;

  /* build the picker */
  SHOTS.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "shot-btn" + (i===0 ? " on" : "");
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Select " + shotName(s));
    const L = "spdf"[s.l];
    const mini = miniIcon(s.l, s.m);
    b.innerHTML = mini + '<span class="sl">' + s.n + L + '<small style="color:var(--faint)"> m=' + (s.m<0?"−":"") + Math.abs(s.m) + '</small></span>';
    b.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      $$(".shot-btn").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("on"));
      b.classList.add("on");
      select(i);
    });
    picker.appendChild(b);
  });

  function miniIcon(l,m){
    const P = (x,y,rx,ry,fill,op,rot)=> '<ellipse cx="'+x+'" cy="'+y+'" rx="'+rx+'" ry="'+ry+'" fill="'+fill+'" opacity="'+op+'" transform="rotate('+(rot||0)+' '+x+' '+y+')"/>';
    if(l===0) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60"><circle r="22" fill="var(--plus)" opacity=".9"/><circle r="3" fill="var(--hot)"/></svg>';
    if(l===1){
      if(m===0) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(0,-14,11,15,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(0,14,11,15,"var(--minus)",.8)+'<line x1="-26" y1="0" x2="26" y2="0" stroke="var(--faint)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>';
      if(m===1) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(14,0,15,11,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(-14,0,15,11,"var(--minus)",.8)+'<line x1="0" y1="-26" x2="0" y2="26" stroke="var(--faint)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/></svg>';
      return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-11,-11,11,8,"var(--minus)",.8,45)+P(11,11,11,8,"var(--plus)",.9,45)+'</svg>';
    }
    if(l===2){
      if(m===0) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(0,-15,10,14,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(0,15,10,14,"var(--plus)",.9)+'<ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="16" ry="6" fill="var(--minus)" opacity=".8"/></svg>';
      if(Math.abs(m)===2) return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-13,-13,9,6,"var(--plus)",.9,45)+P(13,-13,9,6,"var(--minus)",.8,-45)+P(13,13,9,6,"var(--plus)",.9,45)+P(-13,13,9,6,"var(--minus)",.8,-45)+'</svg>';
      return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(-13,0,9,13,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(13,0,9,13,"var(--minus)",.8)+P(0,-13,13,9,"var(--minus)",.8)+P(0,13,13,9,"var(--plus)",.9)+'</svg>';
    }
    return '<svg viewBox="-30 -30 60 60">'+P(0,-18,7,12,"var(--plus)",.9)+P(0,18,7,12,"var(--minus)",.8)+P(-14,-8,9,6,"var(--minus)",.75,-30)+P(14,8,9,6,"var(--plus)",.75,-30)+P(14,-8,9,6,"var(--plus)",.75,30)+P(-14,8,9,6,"var(--minus)",.75,30)+'</svg>';
  }

  function select(i){
    shot = SHOTS[i];
    currentRMax = 3.5 + 4.2 * shot.n;
    const COUNT = 5200;
    pts = [];

    // Pre-pass: Estimate peak probability density to ensure uniform unbiased rejection sampling
    let peakProb = 1e-12;
    for(let step = 0; step < 2400; step++){
      const testR = Math.random() * currentRMax;
      const testTh = Math.acos(2 * Math.random() - 1);
      const testPh = Math.random() * TAU;
      const testY = Ylm(shot.l, shot.m, testTh, testPh);
      const testRnl = radial(shot.n, shot.l, testR);
      const testPsi = testRnl * testY;
      const prob = (testR * testR) * (testPsi * testPsi);
      if(prob > peakProb) peakProb = prob;
    }
    peakProb *= 1.15; // safety margin

    let guard = 0;
    while(pts.length < COUNT && guard < COUNT * 70){
      guard++;
      const r = Math.random() * currentRMax;
      const th = Math.acos(2 * Math.random() - 1);
      const ph = Math.random() * TAU;
      const Y = Ylm(shot.l, shot.m, th, ph);
      const Rr = radial(shot.n, shot.l, r);
      const psi = Rr * Y;
      const prob = (r * r) * (psi * psi);

      if(prob > peakProb) peakProb = prob * 1.05;
      if(Math.random() < prob / peakProb){
        pts.push([
          r * Math.sin(th) * Math.cos(ph),
          r * Math.sin(th) * Math.sin(ph),
          r * Math.cos(th),
          prob,
          psi >= 0 ? 1 : -1
        ]);
      }
    }
    maxA = peakProb;

    const rad = shot.n - shot.l - 1, ang = shot.l;
    $("#orbLabel").textContent = "ψ = " + orbitalLabel(shot) + " (" + shotName(shot) + ")";
    $("#orbStats").textContent = "nodes " + (shot.n - 1) + " · radial " + rad + " · angular " + ang;
    $("#roN").textContent = shot.n;
    $("#roL").textContent = shot.l;
    $("#roM").textContent = shot.m;
    $("#roNodes").textContent = shot.n - 1;
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }

  function resize(){
    dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio||1);
    const b = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = b.width; H = b.height;
    cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  }

  function draw(){
    const pal = palette();
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2, S = Math.min(W,H)/2 / (currentRMax * 1.08);

    /* coordinate axes */
    const rotVec = (u)=>{
      let x=u[0], y=u[1], z=u[2];
      let c=Math.cos(rotY), s=Math.sin(rotY);
      let x2 = x*c - z*s, z2 = x*s + z*c;
      let c2=Math.cos(rotX), s2=Math.sin(rotX);
      let y2 = y*c2 - z2*s2, z3 = y*s2 + z2*c2;
      return [x2, y2, z3];
    };

    const ax = (u, label)=>{
      const v = rotVec(u);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - v[0]*S*currentRMax*0.9, cy - v[1]*S*currentRMax*0.9);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + v[0]*S*currentRMax*0.9, cy + v[1]*S*currentRMax*0.9);
      ctx.strokeStyle = pal.line; ctx.globalAlpha = .32; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if(label){
        ctx.fillStyle = pal.faint; ctx.font = "10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
        ctx.fillText(label, cx + v[0]*S*currentRMax*0.94 - 3, cy + v[1]*S*currentRMax*0.94);
      }
    };

    ax([1,0,0], "x");
    ax([0,1,0], "y");
    ax([0,0,1], "z");

    /* nucleus marker */
    ctx.fillStyle = pal.hot; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,3.5,0,TAU); ctx.fill();

    const cX=Math.cos(rotX), sX=Math.sin(rotX), cY=Math.cos(rotY), sY=Math.sin(rotY);
    const list = [];
    for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
      const p = pts[i];
      let x=p[0], y=p[1], z=p[2];
      let x2 = x*cY - z*sY, z2 = x*sY + z*cY;
      let y2 = y*cX - z2*sX, z3 = y*sX + z2*cX;
      const depth = (z3 + currentRMax) / (2 * currentRMax);
      const a = clamp(p[3] / maxA, 0, 1);
      list.push([cx + x2*S, cy + y2*S, depth, a, p[4]]);
    }

    /* Painter's algorithm: sort depth far-to-near */
    list.sort((A,B)=> A[2]-B[2]);
    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      const P = list[i];
      const d = clamp(P[2], 0, 1);
      const size = (1.1 + d*2.2);
      const alpha = (.12 + d*.48) * (.30 + .70*P[3]);
      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(alpha, 0, .85);
      /* Colour by genuine wavefunction sign: positive lobe vs negative lobe */
      ctx.fillStyle = P[4] >= 0 ? pal.plus : pal.minus;
      ctx.fillRect(P[0]-size/2, P[1]-size/2, size, size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  let last = 0;
  function loop(ts){
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    if(ts - last < 16) return;
    last = ts;
    if(auto && !dragging) rotY += .005;
    draw();
  }
  cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", e=>{ dragging = true; px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY; cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); });
  cv.addEventListener("pointermove", e=>{
    if(!dragging) return;
    rotY += (e.clientX - px) * .008;
    rotX = clamp(rotX + (e.clientY - py) * .008, -1.4, 1.4);
    px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY;
    if(reduceMotion) draw();
  });
  ["pointerup","pointercancel","pointerleave"].forEach(ev=> cv.addEventListener(ev, ()=> dragging=false));

  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(cv);
  const visIO = new IntersectionObserver(es=>{
    es.forEach(e=>{
      if(e.isIntersecting){ if(!raf && !reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
      else if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; }
    });
  },{threshold:.05});
  visIO.observe(cv);
  cv._repaint = draw;
  select(0);
  return {canvas: cv, select};
})();

/* =====================================================================
   4 · Shape cards → jump to the matching shot in the 3D lab
   ===================================================================== */
window.__swRepaint = function(){
  ["heroCanvas","labCanvas","orbCanvas"].forEach(id=>{
    const c = document.getElementById(id);
    if(c && c._repaint) c._repaint();
  });
};
$$(".shape").forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    const n = +el.dataset.n;
    const l = "spdf".indexOf(el.dataset.l);
    const m = el.dataset.m !== undefined ? +el.dataset.m : 0;
    const idx = SHOTS.findIndex(s => s.n === n && s.l === l && (el.dataset.m === undefined || s.m === m));
    if(idx >= 0){
      const btns = $$(".shot-btn");
      btns.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("on"));
      btns[idx].classList.add("on");
      orb.select(idx);
      document.getElementById("lab2").scrollIntoView({behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth"});
    }
  });
});

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Standingwaves — Standing Waves in Electron Orbitals</title>
<meta name="description" content="An interactive study of how standing de Broglie waves wrap around the nucleus and arrange themselves into the electron orbitals.">
<script>/* set theme before first paint */ try{ if(localStorage.getItem("sw-theme")==="light") document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme","light"); }catch(e){} </script>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2064%2064'%3E%3Ccircle%20cx='32'%20cy='32'%20r='27'%20fill='none'%20stroke='%238fb8ff'%20stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle%20cx='32'%20cy='32'%20r='7'%20fill='%23ff5468'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300..900;1,9..144,300..900&family=Instrument+Sans:ital,wght@0,400..700;1,400..700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ================= TOKENS ================= */
:root{
  --bg:#0a0f1e; --bg-2:#0d1526; --bg-3:#121b30; --panel:#0f1830; --card:#101a31;
  --line:rgba(150,172,214,.15); --line-strong:rgba(150,172,214,.34);
  --text:#e9eef8; --muted:#94a3bd; --faint:#5f6f8c;
  --accent:#7fa6ff; --accent-2:#4fd8c8; --hot:#ff5468; --gold:#ffc76b;
  --shadow:0 18px 50px -12px rgba(2,6,16,.65);
  --glow-a:rgba(96,140,255,.16); --glow-b:rgba(79,216,200,.10); --glow-c:rgba(255,84,104,.08);
  --plus:#8fb8ff; --minus:#ff5468;
  --noise:.04;
}
html[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg:#f5f2ea; --bg-2:#efeadd; --bg-3:#e7e1d2; --panel:#fbfaf5; --card:#fcfbf7;
  --line:rgba(56,68,100,.16); --line-strong:rgba(56,68,100,.38);
  --text:#1c2333; --muted:#5a6579; --faint:#8b94a7;
  --accent:#2a4fd0; --accent-2:#0e8578; --hot:#d63853; --gold:#a06a10;
  --shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(40,50,80,.35);
  --glow-a:rgba(42,79,208,.10); --glow-b:rgba(14,133,120,.08); --glow-c:rgba(214,56,83,.06);
  --plus:#2a55c8; --minus:#d63853;
  --noise:.05;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth; scroll-padding-top:84px}
body{
  margin:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
  font-family:"Instrument Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  font-size:16px; line-height:1.65; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  transition:background .5s ease, color .5s ease;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
body::before{ /* ambient glow fields */
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:-25%; z-index:-2; pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(42% 34% at 18% 12%, var(--glow-a), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(38% 32% at 84% 78%, var(--glow-b), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(30% 26% at 78% 14%, var(--glow-c), transparent 70%);
  animation:drift 34s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
body::after{ /* film grain */
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:1000; pointer-events:none; opacity:var(--noise);
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20width='160'%20height='160'%3E%3Cfilter%20id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence%20type='fractalNoise'%20baseFrequency='0.9'%20numOctaves='2'%20stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect%20width='160'%20height='160'%20filter='url(%23n)'%20opacity='0.6'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translate3d(-2%,-1%,0) rotate(0deg)}to{transform:translate3d(2.5%,2%,0) rotate(2deg)}}
::selection{background:var(--accent); color:#fff}
a{color:var(--accent)}
img,svg,canvas{max-width:100%}
button{font:inherit; color:inherit; background:none; border:0; cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:6px}

.wrap{width:min(1160px, 92vw); margin-inline:auto}
.kicker{
  font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.28em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.7em;
}
.kicker::before{content:""; width:26px; height:1px; background:var(--accent); opacity:.7}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif; font-weight:560; line-height:1.12; letter-spacing:-.01em; margin:0}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.8rem)}
h2 em, h1 em{font-style:italic; color:var(--accent-2)}
h3{font-size:1.25rem}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
.lede{font-size:clamp(1.02rem, 1.5vw, 1.16rem); color:var(--muted); max-width:60ch}
.lede strong{color:var(--text); font-weight:600}

/* ================= NAV ================= */
.nav{
  position:fixed; inset:0 0 auto 0; z-index:100; backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 72%, transparent);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  transition:box-shadow .3s ease, background .5s ease;
}
.nav.scrolled{box-shadow:0 10px 30px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.nav-inner{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1.4rem; height:64px}
.brand{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.55rem; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); margin-right:auto}
.brand .mark{width:26px; height:26px; align-self:center}
.brand-name{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-weight:640; font-size:1.08rem; letter-spacing:.01em}
.brand-sub{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.24em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint)}
.nav-links{display:flex; gap:.2rem; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none}
.nav-links::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav-links a{
  position:relative; text-decoration:none; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500;
  padding:.45em .8em; border-radius:999px; white-space:nowrap; transition:color .2s, background .2s;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text); background:var(--bg-3)}
.nav-links a::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; left:.8em; right:.8em; bottom:.18em; height:2px; border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--accent); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
}
.nav-links a.active{color:var(--text)}
.nav-links a.active::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.progress{position:absolute; left:0; bottom:-1px; height:2px; width:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2)); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left}

/* theme toggle */
.theme-toggle{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.55rem; padding:.32rem .55rem; border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px; background:var(--bg-2); transition:border-color .25s, background .5s;
}
.theme-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.theme-toggle svg{width:15px; height:15px}
.tg{position:relative; width:42px; height:22px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--bg-3); border:1px solid var(--line-strong); flex:none}
.tg-knob{
  position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.3,1.2), background .4s;
}
html[data-theme="light"] .tg-knob{transform:translateX(20px); background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f5b53f,#ff8a3d)}
.theme-label{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); min-width:3.2em; text-align:left}

/* ================= HERO ================= */
.hero{position:relative; min-height:94svh; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:118px 0 64px; overflow:visible}
.hero-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.06fr .94fr; gap:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,4rem); align-items:center; width:100%}
.hero-title{font-size:clamp(2.7rem, 6vw, 4.9rem); letter-spacing:-.02em; margin:.35em 0 .4em}
.hero-title .thin{font-weight:340; color:var(--muted)}
.hero .lede{margin-bottom:2.2rem}
.hero-ctas{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.9rem; align-items:center}
.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55em; text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;
  padding:.8em 1.35em; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:transform .25s, box-shadow .25s, background .25s, border-color .25s;
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--text); color:var(--bg)}
.btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 30px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 55%, transparent)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line-strong); color:var(--text)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent)}
.hero-meta{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.6rem 1.8rem; margin-top:2.6rem; padding-top:1.4rem; border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.hero-meta div{font-size:13px; color:var(--muted)}
.hero-meta b{display:block; font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint); font-weight:500; margin-bottom:.2em}
.hero-meta span{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:1.25rem; color:var(--text)}

.hero-visual{position:relative; height:clamp(430px, 62vh, 620px)}
.orb-canvas{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block}
.hero-caption{
  position:absolute; left:14px; bottom:6px; font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10.5px;
  letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--faint); display:flex; gap:.8em; align-items:center;
}
.hero-caption .dot{width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-2); box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent-2); animation:pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}
.scroll-hint{position:absolute; bottom:26px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; color:var(--faint); font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.3em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none}
.scroll-hint .chev{width:1px; height:34px; background:linear-gradient(var(--faint), transparent); animation:fall 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fall{0%{transform:scaleY(.2); transform-origin:top}55%{transform:scaleY(1); transform-origin:top}56%{transform-origin:bottom}100%{transform:scaleY(.2); transform-origin:bottom}}

/* ================= SECTIONS ================= */
.section{padding:clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 7.5rem) 0; position:relative; z-index:1}
.sec-head{max-width:760px; margin-bottom:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.4rem)}
.sec-head h2{margin:.4em 0 .5em}
.sec-alt{background:var(--bg-2); border-block:1px solid var(--line)}

/* reveal on scroll */
[data-reveal]{opacity:0; transform:translateY(26px); transition:opacity .8s ease, transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); transition-delay:var(--d,0s)}
[data-reveal].in{opacity:1; transform:none}

/* ================= WAVE LAB ================= */
.lab{display:grid; grid-template-columns:340px 1fr; gap:1.4rem; align-items:stretch}
.lab-side{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1.4rem}
.panel{
  background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; padding:1.4rem 1.4rem 1.5rem;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow); transition:background .5s, border-color .5s;
}
.panel h3{display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.panel h3 .tag{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint); font-weight:500}
.ctrl{margin-bottom:1.35rem}
.ctrl:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.ctrl-head{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; margin-bottom:.55rem}
.ctrl-head label{font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600}
.ctrl-head .val{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--accent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); padding:.15em .6em; border-radius:6px}
input[type="range"]{
  -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; width:100%; height:26px; background:transparent; cursor:pointer;
}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:4px; border-radius:4px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent) var(--fill,50%), var(--bg-3) var(--fill,50%))}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track{height:4px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--bg-3)}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-progress{height:4px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--accent)}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; margin-top:-6px;
  background:var(--text); border:3px solid var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent);
  transition:transform .15s;
}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text);border:3px solid var(--accent)}
.chips{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.5rem}
.chip{
  font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11.5px; padding:.5em .9em; border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--muted); transition:all .2s;
}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--text); transform:translateY(-1px)}
.chip.on{background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:#fff; font-weight:700}
html[data-theme="light"] .chip.on{color:#fff}
.verdict{
  border-radius:14px; padding:1em 1.15em; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5; border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--bg-3); transition:all .4s;
}
.verdict b{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:1.02rem; display:block; margin-bottom:.15em}
.verdict.ok{border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 55%, transparent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 10%, var(--bg-3))}
.verdict.ok b{color:var(--accent-2)}
.verdict.bad{border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hot) 50%, transparent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hot) 9%, var(--bg-3))}
.verdict.bad b{color:var(--hot)}
.lab-main{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1rem}
.stage{
  position:relative; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow); aspect-ratio:16/8.6; min-height:280px;
}
.stage::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background-image:linear-gradient(var(--line) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size:28px 28px; opacity:.5}
.stage canvas{position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; display:block}
.stage .hud{position:absolute; font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--faint); pointer-events:none}
.hud-tl{top:12px; left:14px}
.hud-tr{top:12px; right:14px; color:var(--accent)}
.hud-bl{bottom:10px; left:14px}
.lab-note{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); background:var(--card); border:1px dashed var(--line-strong); border-radius:14px; padding:1em 1.2em}
.lab-note b{color:var(--text)}
.eq{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:.95em; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent); padding:.15em .45em; border-radius:6px; white-space:nowrap}
sub,sup{font-size:.72em}

/* ================= SHOT GRID ================= */
.shot-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:1.2rem}
.shot{
  background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; padding:1.2rem 1.2rem 1rem;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.9rem; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-color .35s, box-shadow .35s, background .5s;
}
.shot:hover{transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--line-strong); box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.shot .num{
  position:absolute; top:.6rem; right:1rem; font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-style:italic; font-size:2.6rem;
  color:var(--faint); opacity:.35; line-height:1; pointer-events:none;
}
.shot-visual{
  position:relative; border-radius:12px; background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 7%, transparent), transparent 72%),
    var(--bg-2);
  border:1px solid var(--line); aspect-ratio:1; display:grid; place-items:center;
}
.shot-visual::before{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; margin:auto; width:64%; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%;
  border:1px dashed var(--line-strong); opacity:.55; animation:spin 46s linear infinite;
}
.shot:nth-child(2n) .shot-visual::before{animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.shot-visual svg{position:relative; width:78%; height:78%}
.shot h3{font-size:1.18rem; margin-top:.15rem}
.shot .desc{font-size:13.8px; color:var(--muted); flex:1; margin-bottom:0}
.shot .facts{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.45rem; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:.8rem}
.fact{display:flex; gap:.7em; font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11.5px; align-items:baseline}
.fact .k{color:var(--faint); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:9.8px; min-width:6.2em}
.fact .v{color:var(--text)}
.fact .v em{font-style:italic; color:var(--accent-2)}

/* ================= QUANTUM LAB ================= */
.qlab{display:grid; grid-template-columns:330px 1fr; gap:1.4rem; align-items:start}
.shots{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(118px,1fr)); gap:.7rem}
.shot-btn{
  position:relative; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-2); border-radius:12px; padding:.55rem .4rem .5rem;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.3rem; transition:all .22s;
}
.shot-btn svg{width:52px; height:52px}
.shot-btn .sl{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted)}
.shot-btn:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong); transform:translateY(-2px)}
.shot-btn.on{border-color:var(--accent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, var(--bg-2)); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent)}
.shot-btn.on .sl{color:var(--text); font-weight:700}
.qlab-view{
  position:relative; border-radius:18px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow); aspect-ratio:1; max-height:640px; overflow:hidden;
}
.qlab-view canvas{width:100%; height:100%; display:block; cursor:grab; touch-action:none}
.qlab-view canvas:active{cursor:grabbing}
.qlab-view .hud{position:absolute; font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; color:var(--faint); pointer-events:none}
.hud-l{left:14px; top:12px}
.hud-r{right:14px; top:12px; color:var(--accent)}
.qlab-view .hint{left:14px; bottom:10px}
.q-readout{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1.6rem; padding:1rem .2rem 0}
.q-readout div{font-size:13px; color:var(--muted)}
.q-readout b{display:block; font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint); font-weight:500}
.q-readout span{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:1.3rem; color:var(--text)}
.q-readout .accent{color:var(--accent)}

/* ================= SHAPES ================= */
.shapes{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:1.1rem; margin-top:2.4rem}
.shape{
  background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:1rem .8rem 1.1rem;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.55rem; text-align:center;
  transition:transform .3s, border-color .3s, box-shadow .3s, background .5s; cursor:pointer;
}
.shape:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.shape svg{width:86px; height:86px; transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.shape:hover svg{transform:rotate(6deg) scale(1.05)}
.shape .tag{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text)}
.shape .tag em{font-style:italic; color:var(--accent)}
.shape .mdeg{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--faint)}

/* ================= NUMBERS ================= */
.numbers{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1.1rem}
.stat{
  border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--card); border-radius:16px; padding:1.5rem 1.4rem;
  transition:transform .3s, border-color .3s, background .5s; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.stat::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0 0; height:3px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2)); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.stat:hover{transform:translateY(-5px); border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.stat:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.stat .big{font-family:"Fraunces",serif; font-size:clamp(1.7rem,2.6vw,2.3rem); font-weight:600; line-height:1.1; letter-spacing:-.01em}
.stat .big small{font-size:.5em; color:var(--muted); font-weight:400; font-style:italic}
.stat .lab2{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-top:.5rem}
.stat p{font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin:.7rem 0 0}

/* ================= TIMELINE ================= */
.tl{position:relative; margin-top:3rem; padding-left:2.2rem; max-width:860px}
.tl::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:9px; top:8px; bottom:8px; width:2px; background:linear-gradient(var(--accent), var(--accent-2) 60%, transparent); border-radius:2px}
.tl-item{position:relative; padding:0 0 2.1rem}
.tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.tl-item::before{
  content:""; position:absolute; left:-2.2rem; top:.5em; width:14px; height:14px; margin-left:3px;
  border-radius:50%; background:var(--bg); border:3px solid var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
  transition:transform .3s;
}
.tl-item:hover::before{transform:scale(1.25)}
.tl-year{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.22em; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700}
.tl-item h3{font-size:1.22rem; margin:.25em 0 .3em}
.tl-item p{color:var(--muted); font-size:14.5px; margin:0; max-width:62ch}
.tl-item p b{color:var(--text)}

/* ================= CLOSER ================= */
.closer{border-block:1px solid var(--line); background:
  radial-gradient(50% 60% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent), transparent 70%), var(--bg-2)}

      <span class="kicker" data-scramble>Quantum mechanics · de Broglie · Bohr–Sommerfeld</span>
      <h1 class="hero-title">Standing <span class="thin">waves</span><br>in electron <em>orbitals</em></h1>
      <p class="lede">An electron bound to a nucleus does not orbit like a planet. It is a <strong>de Broglie wave</strong> that can only persist in one precise way — as a <strong>standing wave</strong> that closes on itself. Where those waves fit, atoms live. Where they don’t fit, nothing is allowed.</p>
      <div class="hero-ctas">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#standing">Open the wave lab
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>
        </a>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#shots">Jump to the quantum shots</a>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-meta">
        <div><b>Standing condition</b><span>2πr = nλ</span></div>

      </div>
